plugins.name: feasibility
plugins.description: The feasibility role on contract v3: can it be built, may it be built — four probes (technical, prior_art, legal_regulatory, threat_model), each resolved with evidence before any verdict; spec read without the market argument; verdict go|no-go|conditional plus the measurement design. Ships skills: spike-report, stride-table, license-scan, build-vs-buy, reversibility-tag.

plugins.name: madr-options
plugins.description: MADR's candidates/options-considered discipline: plural candidates, one-line rejection reasons, carried forward from phase-1 proposals into phase-2 records. Self-contained — own SessionStart directive fragment and PreToolUse gate; not a standalone role.

plugins.name: nygard-adr-spine
plugins.description: Nygard's minimal ADR spine (Title/Status/Context/Decision/Consequences) plus Risks disposition, as the phase-2 record base shape. Self-contained — own SessionStart directive fragment and PreToolUse gate; not a standalone role.

plugins.name: evidence-citation
plugins.description: OpenSSF-Scorecard-style mandatory evidence citation format (<claim> — <source>), no bare assertions, carried forward across phases. Self-contained — own SessionStart directive fragment and PreToolUse gate; not a standalone role.
